node: Dispatchable power equipment, gas turbines, balance-of-plant, and backup generation
summary: Layer 1B expands the dispatchable-power and backup-generation node with a two-lane universe. The reference lane is GE Vernova as the obvious gas-turbine OEM context anchor. The underfollowed lane is more interesting for Serenity-style bottleneck work: Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and engineered electrical rooms tied to behind-the-meter power; CECO Environmental for gas-turbine exhaust, inlet-air, emissions, acoustic and thermal compliance systems; and Graham Corporation as a lower-mindshare heat-transfer, vacuum, fluid and power-production component supplier with exposure to energy/process, SMR and power-generation applications. Evidence strength is uneven: GEV, POWL and CECO have explicit recent order/backlog evidence; GHM is included as a hypothesis requiring order-level verification.
